findings.reason: Historical issuer and depeg material does not establish a current or final direct-redemption process, remaining liabilities, reserve disposition, or final legal responsibility. Existing explicit unknowns remain the safest canonical state.

The current poundtoken.io domain no longer presents the historical issuer, reserve, or redemption service, but domain repurposing does not prove the legal issuer's dissolution, a precise end date, or the final redemption outcome. Existing unknown lifecycle and issuer states remain unchanged.

The current RLUSD User Terms remain dated 2024-10-03 and continue to support the customer-only one-to-one redemption profile already normalized in PR #354. No source-versioned change requiring a new canonical override was found.

Paxos terms last modified 2026-06-30 identify Paxos Digital Singapore and Paxos Issuance Europe as joint USDG issuers, state their licensing bases, limit direct purchase and redemption to verified customers, and provide one-to-one redemption, minimum, fee, settlement, and segregation terms.

Current Sky disclosures identify USDS as the native stablecoin of Sky Protocol, describe system collateral backing and decentralized governance, and state that Sky.money is a non-custodial interface without control over protocol contracts or governance. This supports a protocol-asset legal profile without a direct corporate holder claim.
